sv.title: Fler anställda i privata sektorn i USA
sv.summary: Antalet sysselsatta i den privata sektorn i USA ökade med 21.000 personer i snitt per vecka under fyraveckorsperioden till och med den 7 november.

en.title: More employees in the US private sector
en.summary: The number of people employed in the US private sector rose by an average of 21,000 per week during the four-week period up to and including 7 November.
